# System permission catalog

<!-- MACHINE GENERATED: DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE DIRECTLY. -->

!!! info "Source of truth"
    This page is generated from `api/config/bootstrap/rbac/permissions.seed.ndjson` by
    `scripts/export_permissions_reference.py`. Edit the bootstrap catalog and regenerate this page.

Coyote3 installs these permissions into an empty database. They are application contracts:
administrators can assign them through roles, but cannot rename or delete them. A disabled
permission grants no access until it is reactivated.

## Analysis Actions

| Permission ID | Label | What it permits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cnv:manage` | Manage CNVs | Review CNVs and apply supported curation actions within the current user's sample scope. |
| `fusion:manage` | Manage Fusions | Review fusion findings and apply supported curation actions within the current user's sample scope. |
| `gene.annotation:view` | View gene annotations | Search tiered findings and annotations for a gene across samples visible to the current user. |
| `pgx:manage` | Manage PGx | Review pharmacogenomic findings and apply supported curation actions within the current user's sample scope. |
| `sample.comment:add` | Add sample comment | Create a sample-specific comment used during review and report preparation. |
| `sample.comment:hide` | Hide sample comment | Hide a sample comment without deleting its audit history. |
| `sample.comment:unhide` | Unhide sample comment | Restore a previously hidden sample comment. |
| `snv:manage` | Manage SNVs | Review small variants and apply supported curation actions within the current user's sample scope. |
| `translocation:manage` | Manage translocations | Review translocations and apply supported curation actions within the current user's sample scope. |
| `variant.comment:add:global` | Add global variant comment | Create an annotation shared across samples for the same normalized finding identity. |
| `variant.comment:add:own` | Add variant comment | Create a sample-specific finding comment for the current review. |
| `variant.comment:hide` | Hide variant comment | Hide a finding comment or annotation without deleting its audit history. |
| `variant.comment:unhide` | Unhide variant comment | Restore a previously hidden finding comment or annotation. |
| `variant.filter:apply` | Apply variant filters | Apply supported analysis filters to findings within assigned assay and group scope. |

## Application Control Management

| Permission ID | Label | What it permits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `app.controls:edit` | Edit application controls | Change application module, Celery task-family, and retention control values. |
| `app.controls:view` | View application controls | View effective application module, Celery task-family, retention, and observed runtime state. |
| `app.maintenance:run` | Run application maintenance | Queue an explicit operational retention and cleanup maintenance run. |
| `notification.broadcast:create` | Broadcast application notifications | Publish application, feature, maintenance, warning, and security notifications to all, role-targeted, or selected active users. |

## Assay Configuration Management

| Permission ID | Label | What it permits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `assay.config:create` | Create ASPC | Create an assay configuration containing analysis availability, filters, reporting sections, and environment scope. |
| `assay.config:delete` | Delete ASPC | Delete a non-system assay configuration after dependency and authorization checks pass. |
| `assay.config:edit` | Edit ASPC | Edit an assay configuration, creating its next immutable business version where versioned configuration rules apply. |
| `assay.config:list` | List ASPCs | Read assay configuration details, filters, reporting sections, and lifecycle metadata. |
| `assay.config:view` | View ASPC | Read assay configuration details, filters, reporting sections, and lifecycle metadata. |

## User Management

| Permission ID | Label | What it permits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `user:create` | Create user | Create a user account and assign roles within the operator's authority. |
| `user:delete` | Delete user | Delete a non-system user account when hierarchy and self-protection checks permit it. |

## Variant Curation

| Permission ID | Label | What it permits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `coverage.blacklist:manage` | Manage coverage blacklist | Create and remove assay-group-scoped low-coverage blacklist entries. |
| `tier:assign` | Assign tier | Allows assigning or modifying the tier classification of variants for prioritization and reporting. |
| `tier:edit:own` | Edit own tier | Allows editing or changing the assigned tier of a variant within the user's group or assigned samples. |
| `tier:remove:global` | Remove any tier | Grants permission to remove tier classifications from any variant across all samples and groups. |
| `tier:remove:own` | Remove own tier | Allows removal of tier classification from variants within the user's accessible group or samples. |
